```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

######## Load the spending data
spending_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/ST3-SPED-2025.csv"
spending_raw <- read_csv(spending_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

spending_clean <- spending_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>%
  transmute(
    ENTITY_CD   = BEDSCODE,
    ENTITY_NAME = NAME,
    COUNTY_DESC = COUNTY_DESC,
    YEAR        = as.numeric(YEAR),

    # Columns F-H : District Legal spending
    ## Legal_ContractualOther        = as.numeric(`31597:48`),
    ## Legal_MaterialsSupplies       = as.numeric(`31599:48`),
    ## Legal_BOCESServices           = as.numeric(`31601:48`),

    # Columns I-Q, S : SPED spending
    # SPED_InstructionalSalaries = as.numeric(`31993:48`),
    # SPED_NoninstructionalSalaries = as.numeric(`31995:48`),
    SPED_Equipment                = as.numeric(`31997:48`),
    SPED_ContractualOther         = as.numeric(`31999:48`),
    SPED_MaterialsSupplies        = as.numeric(`32001:48`),
    SPED_TuitionPublicDistricts   = as.numeric(`32003:48`),
    SPED_TuitionAllOther          = as.numeric(`32005:48`),
    SPED_Textbooks                = as.numeric(`32009:48`),
    SPED_BOCESServices            = as.numeric(`32011:48`),
    SPED_PaymentsCharterSchools   = as.numeric(`32007:48`)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    ## removing legal
    ## Legal_ContractualOther:SPED_PaymentsCharterSchools,
    SPED_Equipment:SPED_PaymentsCharterSchools,
    # Treat NA as $0, and clip any negative (adjustment) values at $0
    # since a pie chart can't display a negative slice.
    ~ pmax(replace_na(.x, 0), 0)
  ))

######## Special Funds (Special Aid Fund) columns
# Row 2 of the CSV is the "Account Code" row and row 1 is the "Title" row.
# Keep every column whose account code starts with "F", contains an "_", and does
# not contain "_0". Codes without an "_" (e.g. F4256, IDEA federal aid) are
# revenue lines, and the "_0" columns are pre-computed totals.
# Also excluded: transportation (F55xx), Instructional Salaries (_15),
# Noninstructional Salaries (_16), and Employee Benefits (_8).
acct_row  <- spending_raw %>% filter(BEDSCODE == "Account Code")
title_row <- spending_raw %>% filter(BEDSCODE == "Title")

######## SPED (General Fund) columns for chart 1, with real account codes
# looked up from the CSV's "Account Code" row, same as the Special Funds
# chart below. Order here controls both the legend order and which
# spendingColor shade (below) each item gets.
sped_meta <- tibble(
  col       = c("31997:48", "32009:48", "32001:48", "31999:48",
                "32003:48", "32005:48", "32011:48", "32007:48"),
  key       = c("SPED_Equipment", "SPED_Textbooks", "SPED_MaterialsSupplies",
                "SPED_ContractualOther", "SPED_TuitionPublicDistricts",
                "SPED_TuitionAllOther", "SPED_BOCESServices",
                "SPED_PaymentsCharterSchools"),
  item_name = c("Equipment", "Textbooks", "Materials & Supplies",
                "Contractual & Other", "Outside Tuition, Public Schools",
                "Outside Tuition, Other", "BOCES Services", "Charter Schools")
) %>%
  mutate(
    code  = as.character(unlist(acct_row[1, col], use.names = FALSE)),
    label = paste0(item_name, " (", code, ")")
  )

item_order <- c("2", "45", "48", "4", "471", "472", "473", "49")
group_order <- c("School Year", "Early Intervention",
                 "Summer", "Pre-K", "Preschool 12-Month")

sf_meta <- tibble(
  col   = names(spending_raw),
  code  = as.character(unlist(acct_row[1, ],  use.names = FALSE)),
  title = as.character(unlist(title_row[1, ], use.names = FALSE))
) %>%
  filter(
    str_starts(code, "F"),
    str_detect(code, "_"),
    !str_detect(code, "_0"),
    !str_starts(code, "F55"),
    !str_detect(code, "_(15|16|8)$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    key    = paste0("SF_", str_remove(col, ":.*$")),
    prefix = str_extract(code, "^F\\d+"),
    suffix = str_extract(code, "(?<=_)\\d+$"),
    line   = str_match(title, "\\(Line (\\d+),")[, 2],
    group  = case_when(
      prefix == "F2250"           ~ "School Year",
      prefix == "F2251"           ~ "Early Intervention",
      prefix == "F2252"           ~ "Preschool 12-Month",
      prefix == "F2253"           ~ "Summer",
      prefix == "F2510"           ~ "Pre-K"
    ),
    item_name = case_when(
      suffix == "2"   ~ "Equipment",
      suffix == "45"  ~ "Materials & Supplies",
      suffix == "48"  ~ "Textbooks",
      suffix == "4"   ~ "Contractual & Other",
      suffix == "471" ~ "Outside Tuition, Public Schools",
      suffix == "472" ~ "Outside Tuition, Other",
      suffix == "473" ~ "Charter Schools",
      suffix == "49"  ~ "BOCES Services"
    ),
    label = paste0("", item_name, " - ", group, " (", code, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(suffix, item_order), match(group, group_order), line)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sf_meta$label), !anyDuplicated(sf_meta$key))

sf_values <- spending_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>%
  select(all_of(sf_meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ pmax(replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0), 0)))
names(sf_values) <- sf_meta$key

spending_clean <- bind_cols(spending_clean, sf_values)

# Format BEDS Code to prevent scientific notation in JSON serialization
spending_clean$ENTITY_CD <- format(spending_clean$ENTITY_CD, scientific = FALSE)

# Pass data to Observable JS
ojs_define(
  df_to_js     = spending_clean,
  sped_fields_js = sped_meta %>% select(key, label, item_name),
  sf_fields_js = sf_meta %>% select(key, label, item_name)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Transpose merged R dataframe into OJS format
shared_data = transpose(df_to_js)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Identify unique counties and dynamically calculate matching districts
uniqueCounties = new Set(shared_data.map(d => d.COUNTY_DESC).filter(Boolean));

districtsInCounty = new Set(
  shared_data
    .filter(d =>
      d.COUNTY_DESC &&
      d.ENTITY_NAME &&
      d.COUNTY_DESC.toUpperCase() === county.toUpperCase()
    )
    .map(d => d.ENTITY_NAME)
);

districtDefault = {
  county;
  return "";
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Guard function - toolbar architecture (county -> district submit/reset)
function guard(fn, options = {}, countyView) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "100%",
    justify = "start"
  } = options;

  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };
  const submit = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit } } class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">${submitLabel}</button>`;
  const reset = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: true, onclick: onReset } } class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">${resetLabel}</button>`;
  const footer = htl.html`
    <div>
      <hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-style: ${justify} ">
        ${submit}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  const template = inputs => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "input-toolbar";
    row.append(countyView);
    (Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs))
      .forEach(input => row.append(input));
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.style.cssText = "width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box";
    container.append(row, footer);
    return container;
  };
  const input = fn({ submit, reset, footer, template, onSubmit, onReset });
  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, { capture: true });
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);
  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;
  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width: ${width} ">${input}`;
  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: v => { input.value = v }
  });
}
```

  if (!inputSels) return [];
  const district = inputSels.district.trim().toUpperCase();
  return shared_data.filter(d => d.ENTITY_NAME && d.ENTITY_NAME.toUpperCase() === district);

selectedRow = shared_dataFiltered.length ? shared_dataFiltered[0] : null;

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Field list for the pie chart (label shown to user : underlying column)
// SPED fields (built in the R chunk from the CSV's Account Code row)
spedFields = transpose(sped_fields_js);

function toChartData(row, fields) {
  if (!row) return [];
  return fields
    .map(f => ({ label: f.label, value: +row[f.key] || 0 }))
    .filter(d => d.value > 0);
}

spedChartData = toChartData(selectedRow, spedFields);

// Special Funds fields (built in the R chunk from the CSV's Account Code row)
sfFields = transpose(sf_fields_js);
sfChartData = toChartData(selectedRow, sfFields);
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Color scale for the General Funds

spendingColor = {
  // Same hue family, stepped through lightness for the items in each group
  const EquipMaterialShades = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateYlOrBr(0.1 + t * 0.2), 3);
  const TuitionShades   = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateBlues(0.3 + t * 0.7), 4);    
//  const legalShades  = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateReds(0.5 + t * 0.8), 3); 
  const SPEDContracts  = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateGreens(.5), 1); 


  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(spedFields.map(f => f.label))
    .range([
      EquipMaterialShades[0],   // Equipment
      EquipMaterialShades[1],   // Textbooks
      EquipMaterialShades[2],   // Materials & Supplies
      SPEDContracts[0],  // Contractual & Other
      TuitionShades[0],  // Outside Tuition, Public Schools
      TuitionShades[1],  // Outside Tuition, Other
      TuitionShades[2],  // BOCES Services
      TuitionShades[3]  // Charter Schools
      // legalShades[0],  // Legal - Contractual & Other
      // legalShades[1],  // Legal - Materials & Supplies
      // legalShades[2]   // Legal - BOCES Services
    ]);
}
  
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Color scale for the Special Funds

sfColor = {
  // Groups with a single static color (no gradient) go here.
  const staticColors = {
    "Outside Tuition, Public Schools": d3.interpolateBlues(.3),
    "Outside Tuition, Other":          d3.interpolateBlues(.4),
    "Charter Schools":                 d3.interpolateBlues(.5),
    "BOCES Services":                  d3.interpolateBlues(.7)
  };
  // Groups shaded across a range of a d3 interpolator go here.
  const interps = {
    "Equipment":           d3.interpolateYlOrBr,
    "Materials & Supplies": d3.interpolateYlOrBr,
    "Textbooks":            d3.interpolateYlOrBr,
    "Contractual & Other":  d3.interpolateGreens
  };
  // Per-color lightness band [min, max]; anything not listed uses the default.
  const defaultRange = [0.4, 0.9];
  const ranges = {
    "Equipment":            [0.1, 0.35],
    "Materials & Supplies": [0.1, 0.35],
    "Textbooks":            [0.1, 0.35]
  };
  const groups = d3.group(sfFields, f => f.item_name);
  const colorOf = new Map();
  for (const [g, members] of groups) {
    if (staticColors[g]) {
      members.forEach(f => colorOf.set(f.label, staticColors[g]));
      continue;
    }
    const interp = interps[g] || d3.interpolateGreys;
    const [lo, hi] = ranges[g] || defaultRange;
    members.forEach((f, i) => {
      const t = members.length === 1 ? 0.7 : i / (members.length - 1);
      colorOf.set(f.label, interp(lo + (hi - lo) * t));
    });
  }
  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(sfFields.map(f => f.label))
    .range(sfFields.map(f => colorOf.get(f.label)));
}

```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// One color per item type (Equipment, Materials & Supplies, etc.), reused by
// the combined chart below. Pulled directly from sfColor so a category's
// color always matches what it already looks like in the Special Aid Fund
// chart (sfColor is the more general of the two: every item type gets a
// distinct color there, vs. spendingColor above where a couple of item
// types share a hue and are only told apart by position).
itemColor = {
  const byItem = new Map(sfFields.map(f => [f.item_name, sfColor(f.label)]));
  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([...byItem.keys()])
    .range([...byItem.values()]);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Combined chart data: sum the General Fund (spedFields) and Special Aid
// Fund (sfFields) values together by item type, so e.g. every "Materials &
// Supplies" account across both funds becomes one slice.
combinedChartData = {
  const totals = new Map();
  function addFields(fields) {
    for (const f of fields) {
      const v = +selectedRow?.[f.key] || 0;
      totals.set(f.item_name, (totals.get(f.item_name) || 0) + v);
    }
  }
  if (selectedRow) {
    addFields(spedFields);
    addFields(sfFields);
  }
  return Array.from(totals, ([label, value]) => ({ label, value }))
    .filter(d => d.value > 0);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Reusable pie chart (d3), with a % label on larger slices and a legend.
function pieChart(data, { title = "", color = spendingColor, maxHeight = 350 } = {}) {
  const drawWidth = 460, drawHeight = 440;
  // The SVG scales to 100% of its container's width, with height following
  // automatically to keep the drawing's proportions (drawWidth:drawHeight).
  // maxHeight caps how tall that's allowed to get on a wide container by
  // capping the equivalent max-width, since height = width * (drawHeight/drawWidth).
  const maxWidth = maxHeight * (drawWidth / drawHeight);

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return html`<div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:60px 20px;">
      <strong>${title}</strong><br>No spending reported for this district.
    </div>`;
  }

  const total = d3.sum(data, d => d.value);
  const radius = Math.min(drawWidth, drawHeight) / 2 - 20;

  const arcs = d3.pie().value(d => d.value).sort(null)(data);
  const arcGen = d3.arc().innerRadius(radius * 0.35).outerRadius(radius);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [-drawWidth / 2, -drawHeight / 2, drawWidth, drawHeight])
    .style("width", "100%")
    .style("height", "auto")
    .style("max-width", `${maxWidth}px`)
    .style("display", "block")
    .style("margin", "0 auto")
    .style("font", "12px sans-serif");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(arcs)
    .join("path")
      .attr("d", arcGen)
      .attr("fill", d => color(d.data.label))
      .attr("stroke", "white")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
    .append("title")
      .text(d => `${d.data.label}\n$${Math.round(d.data.value).toLocaleString()} (${((d.data.value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(arcs)
    .join("text")
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${arcGen.centroid(d)})`)
      .style("font-size", "10px")
      .style("font-weight", "600")
      .style("fill", "#fff")
      .text(d => (d.data.value / total) > 0.04 ? `${Math.round((d.data.value / total) * 100)}%` : "");

  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 0)
      .attr("y", -drawHeight / 2 + 16)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .style("font-size", "15px")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .text(title);

const legend = html`<div style="font-size:11px;margin:6px auto 0;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;">
  ${data.map(d => html`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px;margin:2px 0;">
    <span style="width:10px;height:10px;background:${color(d.label)};display:inline-block;border-radius:2px;flex:none;"></span>
    <span>${d.label}: <strong>$${Math.round(d.value).toLocaleString()}</strong></span>
  </div>`)}
</div>`;

return html`<div style="text-align:left;width:100%;">${svg.node()}${legend}</div>`;
}
```
